extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies CJ2310 as an N-channel MOSFET from Jiangsu Changjing Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.; the requested manufacturer string is normalized without punctuation.
Typical Characteristics plots on p. 3 were manually digitized at visible grid-aligned or directly readable points; no points were interpolated between sampled readings.
The datasheet has no capacitance-versus-VDS plot; only tabulated Ciss, Coss, and Crss values were transcribed.
Ciss and Crss rows do not state VDS, VGS, or frequency test conditions in the supplied table; that absence is preserved in their conditions strings.
